gen.title: Steps from meeting to drafting a new framework
gen.orderNote: Follow the order the text presents cause and effect

steps.label: Federal Convention convened
steps.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
steps.orderHint: Track what led to the next decision

steps.label: only two states were at first present
steps.quote: Because the delegations from only two states were at first present, the members adjourned from day to day
steps.orderHint: Track what led to the next decision

steps.label: it became clear by mid-June
steps.quote: it became clear by mid-June that, rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government.
steps.orderHint: Track what led to the next decision

steps.label: in closed sessions, the delegates debated
steps.quote: All through the summer, in closed sessions, the delegates debated, and redrafted the articles of the new Constitution.
steps.orderHint: Track what led to the next decision

steps.label: chief points at issue were how much power
steps.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
steps.orderHint: Track what led to the next decision
